title: Historic Atlas — The anatomy of a place
features: Archival specimen homepage with an original contour illustration, independent location/text confidence controls, language fallback inspector, actual sample JSON export, strict tag-key normalizer and legacy coordinate normalization/swapping lab with SRID and range checks.
limits: Fictional specimen data and local rule demonstrations, not backend storage or a real legacy import. Locale-keyed sample content remains English for this collection. No real audit subjects, identity service, API calls or database transaction. Full importer behavior is explained rather than executed.
